description: Validate an XML instance against its SDC4 XSD schema. Returns pass or fail with error counts.

instance_path.description: Path to the XML instance (Governed Data Record) to validate.

reference_path.description: Optional path to a local copy of the SDC4 reference model (sdc4.xsd). Without it the model's include is fetched from its URL.

schema_path.description: Path to the SDC4 data model XSD file.

name: validate_instance
